What exactly is AI slop anyway? How do you actually define it? Who is behind it all? And what does it mean for the human storytelling that we care about? We journey deep into the muck, and fight our way back out with answers. Shell Game is a multiple award-winning series that has been named one of the best of the year by Apple, The Atlantic, The Guardian, Vulture, The Information, The Economist. Email feedback to show@no-priors.com. Sarah Guo is a startup investor and the founder of Conviction, an investment firm purpose-built to serve intelligent software, or "Software 3.0" companies. She spent nearly a decade incubating and investing at venture firm Greylock Partners. Elad Gil is a serial entrepreneur and a startup investor. Host Shekhar Natarajan has spent his career putting technology into the hands of millions of people at Walmart, Target, Disney and American Eagle. Today he's the founder and CEO of Orchestro.AI. Each episode explores AI, Quantum, Space, Health, Learning, Energy, Robotics, Business and leadership, and Angelic Intelligence. This isn't a show about gadgets.
